about: One entry per scene that uses a variant or a new design. Studios read it to avoid repeating a variant used by either of the last two episodes with that scene (PLAYBOOK step 6¾).

entries.variant: redrawn film poster + zoom into the billing block + highlighter names
entries.note: new scene type 'poster': taped poster (explosion sky, soldier silhouette, title, red subtitle, REDRAWN chip), sticky notes pinned on cue; a second entry zooms into the billing block where every line is an unreadable bar except the credit line, and each name lifts off its bar under a yellow highlighter; everything above the credits darkens on the zoom
one-point corridor, ceiling lights flicker and die, red sigils glow, a [ whispers ] caption, the far door swings open and white fog fills the frame
last location episodes used neon (m139) and gps/paper (021)
a sweep finds the Kingfishers hideout
window shows the day sky, a SLEEP UNTIL menu steps down to the chosen time, eyelids blink shut and open on a night sky with moon and stars

entries.variant: neon ring tunnel + rolling year counter
entries.note: rings pour outwards from a glowing core, sparks spiral in, the year rolls 2026 to 2002 and lands gold with a flash (glow drawn as double strokes: SVG blur filters were 2x slower)

entries.variant: default, 6 stars, used twice (stars on, then cleared)
entries.note: first heat: six stars and three heat icons; second: icons tick off and the title flips to STARS GONE
cream dossier sheet; each value hides under a black bar that peels off on its cue, one row stays redacted with a red NOT LISTED note, highlighter mark, stamp under the sheet
two elevators: OUT OF ORDER sign with a red balloon, the other car opens full of balloons, lights flicker out and a clown face flashes, then gone
Vice Beach at night; the last location episodes used hud

entries.variant: car trunk opens, items rise out, then the car burns
entries.note: drawn red car from behind; lid swings open, gas can + hero revolver cards rise out (UNIQUE chip); second use: flames, cards turn grey, GONE FOR GOOD stamp, NO MISSION REPLAY chip
steps round a ring light up on the words (SAVE, RELOAD, BAGS STAY, BARN REFILLS), the ring fills, REPEAT lands in the middle with a spinning arrow (logged after the fact)
two profile cards with mini gauges (Jason, Lucia), then one big gauge whose needle slides to PSYCHO with a red flash (logged after the fact)
credits roll and stop on one highlighted line (logged after the fact; designs.json did not exist yet)

entries.variant: car stereo tuner; rolling end credits
entries.note: radio: LCD tunes through static to a station with host and a note chip (logged after the fact)
manila case-file tab, evidence bags with drawn exhibits (finger, cleaver, duct tape, shears), numbered yellow markers and a camera flash; one exhibit = big centred bag
receipt hangs from a printer slot and grows line by line (torn edge at the bottom), big total row, a rubber stamp lands at the end
new map styles (hud stays the default); image = pin on a real picture from stills/media
real web pictures (Reddit, store pages…) as taped prints over b-roll
old-game footage inside the TV, handwritten cheat sheets from Reddit, phone dialing
60 FPS reel scenes; fgapp/alt show real app screenshots from media

entries.variant: safe (steel door with keypad swings open, items inside)
entries.note: device 'safe': steel body, LCD and 3x4 keypad on the door, bolts and a handle wheel; after the code the door swings open in 3D and gold-bordered tags pop up from inside (inside[])
president's birthday 010317, ACCESS GRANTED
Friends of Freedom Memorial, Catalan Blvd
Sharktooth Island, north of Waning Sands

entries.variant: security-camera bank vault (round steel door, guard delivery, door swings open)
entries.note: new scene type 'vault': CAM 04 frame with REC, a guard silhouette walks in with a cash bag, the 12 bolts slide back and the wheel spins, the door swings open (3D) on banded cash and gold bars; status pill LOCKED / DELIVERY IN PROGRESS / VAULT OPEN; a 'that's your window' bar drains

entries.variant: fence lead-in (bundle stamped MARKED drops into a buyer chip), then the payout
entries.note: new optional field cash.fence {stamp, to, label, at, toAt}; without it the cash scene draws exactly as before
tail the security van to a big bank

entries.variant: night street side view: pickup winches an ATM out of a wall
entries.note: new scene type 'winch': lit ATM sign in a brick wall under a street lamp; the pickup reverses in, a hook latches on, FLOOR IT fills a winch-tension meter while cracks spread, the machine tears out with debris, dust and a camera shake and is dragged off, leaving a hole; status chip FIND / BACK UP / HOOKED / FLOOR IT / RIPPED OUT
$10,000+ per machine
